statement: Pinned Linux hid-steam IBEX input handler uses byte 2 bit 6 (Menu/start) to schedule a delayed gamepad-mode switch at 45*HZ/100 (nominal 450 ms) when client_opened is false and not already armed, cancels on release, and the callback only acts when lizard_mode is true. It toggles gamepad_mode and calls the existing lizard disable sequence when entering gamepad mode; leaving gamepad mode calls the lizard enable sequence only when client_opened remains false. The callback also clears evdev state on leaving. This is a host delayed-work path, not a proven physical long-press or measured timing. Linux hid-steam.c lines 2441-2458,1487-1521,880-905. Physical hold behavior: No evidence.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.3-rc1 or SDL Triton 6defbc0 host-source pin; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Direct wired USB 28de:1302 source-derived consumer expectation only. All timings are host scheduling assumptions or source comments; physical measurement: No evidence.
